posts.text: The story looks fine to me. But there are two big questions. Given the company’s presence in custom engineered and rugged display systems for industrial, medical, railway and defence applications, what is the strategic rationale for entering passenger automotive displays, which appears to be more competitive, price-sensitive, lower margin carrying (at least initially when they target Tier 2 and Tier 3 OEMs)?
